resources.string: Sign in to upload numbers and see your history. Video analysis works offline.
Use an athlete account here. Coaches can use the web dashboard.
Only numbers are uploaded. Your video and pose landmarks stay on this device.
Camera at knee height and level. Stand still with your whole body and space above your head in frame; use 60 fps.
Analysis uses the first 10 seconds. Keep still briefly before and after the jump.
Numbers to discuss with a coach. Single-camera depth is an estimate; compare your own jumps over time.
No app can open this action. Use Pick video or open a video with JumpScan.
No video returned. Try Pick video.
Open a local video from your camera or files.
Only the first 10 seconds are analysed.
Clip longer than 10 seconds. Only the first 10 seconds were analysed.
Numbers to discuss with a coach. Depth is an estimate.
No video or landmarks are uploaded.
Low frame rate: timing may be less precise.
Tracking lost near take-off or landing: flight time uses the nearest observed frames.
Low visibility: keep hips, knees and feet in view.
No flight detected. Numbers use the start of the clip.
Side view: only the better-seen leg is measured.
Some frames could not be analysed reliably. Try filming again.
No uploaded jumps yet. Analyse a video, then upload your numbers.
Unexpected server response. Please try again.
Your session expired. Sign in again.
Connection timed out. Check the server URL and try again.
Cannot reach the server. Check the server URL and your connection.
Cannot read this video. Open it again from Pick video.
Could not complete this action. Please try again.
Cannot read this video\'s duration. Try another video.
This video has no video track.
This video has too few frames.
Use a video between 10 and 480 frames per second.
This video\'s frame timestamps are too close together. Try another video.
Cannot decode this video. Try an MP4 video from your camera.
Cannot decode this video\'s orientation. Try another video.
No person found. Face the camera with your whole body in frame.
Too few clear frames. Keep hips, knees and feet visible, and try a longer video.
Enter an http:// or https:// server URL.
Login failed or your session expired. Please sign in again.
This account cannot perform this action. Uploads need an athlete account.
Too many login attempts. Please try again later.
Peak knee flexion · no landing found
Video frame with detected hips, knees, ankles and feet. Left leg in blue, right leg in orange. Hidden points are omitted.
Time in the air and height estimated from that time.
Bending at first contact and the deepest bend within the next half second.
Compare leg movement and tracking quality against your own previous jumps.
A level phone at knee height faces a person whose whole body fits inside the frame with headroom.
Place the phone at knee height, level and steady.
Keep your whole body in frame, with space above your head.
Face the camera so both legs are visible.
Use 60 frames per second if your phone allows it.
Stand still for one second before and after the jump.
Film in good light, with the light in front of you.
Sign in with the same athlete account and server to send saved results.
Saved on this device. Sending will retry on next app start, or tap Send pending.
Could not save this result. Keep this screen open and try sending again.
A saved result could not be read. It is still on this device.
A result was sent but its local copy could not be removed. Do not retry until storage is available.
Unclear joints are hidden in this frame. Keep your whole body visible and use good light.
No flight was found automatically. Check the frames to mark take-off and landing, or film again.
Try filming again with the whole body in frame and space above the head.
Mark the first frame with the feet off the ground, then the first frame touching the ground. For a drop jump, mark the rebound take-off.
Set both frames. Landing must follow take-off by at most 1000 ms.
Not enough clear knee frames near this landing. Choose another landing or film again.
Use 60 fps or slow motion if your camera offers it, then pick the video.
